newsitem.title: UK: United News appoints ceo to broking units.
newsitem.headline: United News appoints ceo to broking units.

text.p: United News & Media Plc said on Monday that Gerry Wilton has been appointed chief executive of its broking companies, Harlow Butler and Garbon.
Charles Gregson relinquishes the chief executive role but will continue as chairman of the broking companies.
Wilton said in a statement that the business has performed well during the last year, "we have improved market share and tough control of costs is helping us to hold margins."
"Looking ahead we will be widening our product range, extending our international network and investing in new technology."
